summary: Orders are handed to an outside warehouse that may accept only part of an order. Every amount shown anywhere must equal a twin order placed for only the accepted units, through lost answers and two servers.
ticket_rules: Every placed order reaches the warehouse exactly once, whatever fails or is repeated, through either server.
The order shows what was accepted; units not accepted go back on sale exactly once.
Every amount shown for the order, anywhere, is what the existing pricing rules give for the accepted units.
Placing an order never waits for or fails because of the warehouse.

criteria.text: one shipment through lost answers and repeats
line totals, delivery charge, history and export equal the accepted-units twin
the same checkout sent to both servers at once makes one order

idempotency-under-failure.build: outbox row in the order transaction, worker, lookup before create
idempotency-under-failure.hidden_case_it_fails: zero-accepted line and held units in the CSV export

central_change_risk: Recomputing totals as a sum of accepted lines misses the delivery threshold and per-line rounding.

measured.slips: zero-unit line, held units in export (x2), concurrent checkout on two servers
